subject: Misplaced xlab and use of annote()

messages.author: f08ffc283be66295
messages.subject: Misplaced xlab and use of annote()
parts:
Hi Hadley,

I'm enjoying learning ggplot2. But I've run into a cosmetic problem. Here are four small data files:

messages.author: cb25d91fd630a4e5
messages.subject: Re: Misplaced xlab and use of annote()
parts:
The extra white space is a consequence of opts(aspect.ration=1), and
it's possible that you'll have to wait until Hadley finishes the
layout update to get a true fix, in the meantime, here's a hacked
solution:

ctrl <- read.table('Control.txt', header = TRUE)
tail <- read.table('tail.txt', header = TRUE)
peak <- read.table('Peak.txt', header = TRUE)
noch <- read.table('noChange.txt', header = TRUE)
require(ggplot2)
lo.peak <- loess(y ~ x, data = peak)
loPred.peak <- predict(lo.peak, data.frame(x = 14:73), se = FALSE)
lo.noch <- loess(y ~ x, noch)
loPred.noch <- predict(lo.noch, data.frame(x = 0:47), se = FALSE)
lo.ctrl <- loess(y ~ x, ctrl)
loPred.ctrl <- predict(lo.ctrl, data.frame(x = 13:47), se = FALSE)
lo.tail <- loess(y ~ x, tail)
loPred.tail <- predict(lo.tail, data.frame(x = 12:55), se = FALSE)
bg <- data.frame(time = 0:72, peak = NA, tail = NA, ctrl = NA, noch = NA)
bg$peak[14:73] <- loPred.peak
bg$noch[1:48] <- loPred.noch
bg$ctrl[13:47] <- loPred.ctrl
bg$tail[12:55] <- loPred.tail
bg.s <- with(bg, data.frame(time = rep(time, 4), stack(bg, select = -time)))

bg.note = ddply(
.data = bg.s
, .variables = .(ind)
, .fun = function(x){
x = x[!is.na(x$value),]
x = x[order(x$time),]
x = x[nrow(x),]
labels = c('7.94','7.00','6.98','6.02')
x$label = labels[x$ind==c("peak", "noch", "ctrl", "tail")]
return(x)
}
)
p <- qplot(time, values, colour = ind, data = bg.s, geom = 'line',
xlab = 'time (s) ', ylab = 'momentary
affective responses')
p <- p + scale_colour_hue('ad type (liking)',
breaks = c("peak", "noch", "ctrl", "tail"),
labels = c("positive added (7.94)", "neutral precedes (7.00)",
"control (6.98)", "neutral added (6.02)"))
p <- p + opts(aspect.ratio = 1)
p <- p + geom_text(
data = bg.note
, mapping = aes(
label = label
)
, hjust=0
, legend = FALSE
)
p <- p + scale_x_continuous(
limits = c(0,80)
)
ggsave(p,file='BaumgartnerEtAl1977-Figure1.pdf')
print(p)

parts:
Ah, instead of adding '\n' to the x-axis label, which yields unwanted
white space at the bottom of the plot, you can simply resize
the device:

#create p without adding '\n' to x-axis label, then...
ggsave(p,file='BaumgartnerEtAl1977-Figure1.pdf',height=5,width=7.25)
